name: Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: hybrid: Gated DeltaNet linear attention with full gated attention every 4th layer (16 of 64); partial RoPE
notes: ADDED 2026-11-18. A rl (async-GRPO LoRA) of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, not a new base model: no separate config.json, size inherited from the base's 27.781B. Recorded as a contender because it publishes paired base-vs-adapter evidence on its own card; every row below is card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-11-16 (16 days old at crawl, trendingScore 215). WHAT IT IS: a PEFT LoRA adapter trained to be the model behind the pi coding agent (earendil-works/pi) on SWE and terminal tasks. It is served as base + adapter (vLLM --enable-lora, max-lora-rank 32) or merged; the adapter alone is not runnable, and on this hybrid Gated-DeltaNet base prefix caching needs --mamba-cache-mode align. HARDWARE GATE: passes - active 27.781B <= 40 and 27.781 x 0.5 GiB = 13.9 GiB <= 128, but it is a PEFT adapter, so in practice it is served in 4-bit beside its base rather than run as its own full-precision artifact. KV BASIS: unchanged from the base - config.json layer_types has 16 full_attention layers (3,7,...,63) of 64, num_key_value_heads 4, head_dim 256, so 2 x 16 x 4 x 256 x 2 bytes = 65,536 B/token; the 48 linear-attention layers hold a constant per-sequence state instead of a growing cache. HONESTY CHECKS: (a) step 160 was selected by looking at SWE-bench Pro and an 18-task Terminal-Bench 2.1 subset, so the headline 55.8/62.7 carry selection bias - the card also prints the 68 Terminal-Bench tasks NOT used for selection at 55.9 vs base 39.7 (+16.2, p=0.0074), which is the row to trust; (b) all runs are the author's own single run per task at temperature 0.8 with thinking OFF (the adapter was never trained with thinking), so these are not comparable to thinking-on Terminal-Bench numbers published elsewhere in the catalog; (c) the base column is a real bf16 run under the same pi harness, not another quant, and both share it - that is why the delta is credible. CONFIDENCE 0.6: paired design with sign tests and a held-out split, but one author, one attempt per task, 51-86 task samples.
